senses.gloss: adv. (לחי, cmp. Aeth. la-ḥa-ya to be beautiful; cmp. יָפֶה, כָּשֵׁר) very well, all right.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ruth 3:13">Targ. Ruth III, 13</cite>.—
<cite ref="Gittin 67b:21">Gitt. 67ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>א״ל ל׳</he> said he to him, Very well (do so).
<cite ref="Eruvin 15a:11">Erub. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>בשלמא קמה ל׳</he> as regards grain stacks, very well (they may have been so arranged on purpose); a. fr.
